lots.what_it_is: Hand-built art pottery vase with a wavy lobed rim and applied grape or vine leaves in green over a deep blue glaze. Armitage's own swing tag reads 'Annie Mitchell School 1930s'. The incised base reads a name that looks like 'L. M...ELL' or similar (not clearly 'Mitchell', and not the known 'A.F. Mitchell Goodwood Sth Aus' mark), plus a glaze note that reads like '(LI)GHT GREEN BLUE'. Consistent with a South Australian Mitchell School student piece, not a signed Annie Mitchell.

lots.what_it_is: Late 19th century French barbotine (majolica) flask-shaped mantel clock with high-relief iris, rose and other flowers on a mottled cream and black ground, on four feet. Enamel chapter-ring dial with Roman numerals on white cartouches, painted floral centre, 'SLOW FAST' regulation mark at the top and a partly legible word ending in 'PARIS' at the bottom. Two winding holes (8-day striking movement), pierced back cover. Pointu or Montigny-sur-Loing type, maker not identified.

lots.what_it_is: Typed and photocopied '3RD DRAFT' screenplay of 'Crocodile Dundee', 'Written by Paul Hogan & Ken Shadie', 'PROPERTY OF...JP PRODUCTIONS, 157 Forest Way, Belrose N.S.W.' with a phone number, in a lever-arch binder. Page shown opens with Scene 1 New York City, the New York Tribune, Richard Mason and Sue Charlton, which matches the film's early drafts. JP Productions was the Hogan and John Cornell company. Likely a pre-production copy for cast, crew or financiers; one of a number of copies, not a unique original.
